# KnowledgeHut

> KnowledgeHut is a professional bootcamp and certification provider offering expert-led training in Agile, project management, cloud computing, AI, and enterprise transformation.

KnowledgeHut (part of upGrad) specializes in hands-on certification courses and corporate training programs aligned with industry standards like Scrum Alliance, AXELOS, and SAFe. The platform emphasizes practical learning through live online classes, real-time exercises, and cloud labs across multiple professional domains.

## Key Topics

- Agile Management
- Scrum Certification
- Generative AI
- SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)
- Project Management
- DevOps
- Professional Development
- Certification Programs
- Enterprise Transformation
- Hands-on Learning
- Corporate Training
- Scrum Alliance
- AI-Powered Development
- Business Agility
- Cloud Computing

## Core Certification Programs

- [Certified Scrum Master (CSM) Certification](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/csm-certification-training): CSM certification training by Scrum Alliance with 2-day course, 16 PDUs, and exam preparation.
- [CSPO Certification Training Course](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/cspo-certification-training): CSPO certification training for Scrum Product Owners with live online classes and Scrum Alliance partnership.
- [ITIL 4 Foundation Certification Training](https://www.knowledgehut.com/it-service-management/itil-foundation-certification-training): ITIL 4 Foundation certification by AXELOS covering IT service management essentials and exam prep.
- [SAFe Implementation Roadmap](https://www.knowledgehut.com/safe-transformation): SAFe implementation consulting and training for enterprise agile transformation and lean practices.

## Generative AI & Advanced Technologies

- [Generative AI Course for Scrum Masters](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/gen-ai-for-scrum-masters): Generative AI certification for Scrum Masters integrating ChatGPT and AI tools with Agile processes.
- [Generative AI Course for Project Managers](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/generative-ai-course-for-project-managers): Generative AI course for PMP professionals enhancing project management with AI tools and innovation.
- [Generative AI Course for Product Owners & Product Managers](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/generative-ai-course-for-product-managers): Generative AI training for Product Owners and Managers integrating AI for product innovation.
- [Enterprise Generative AI Course](https://www.knowledgehut.com/agile-management/generative-ai-course-for-enterprise): Enterprise Generative AI certification covering Scrum, Kanban, SAFe with agile transformation focus.
- [Gen AI Course for Business Analysts](https://www.knowledgehut.com/business-management/generative-ai-course-for-business-analysts): Generative AI course for Business Analysts aligned with BABOK and certification standards.
- [AI-Powered Software Development Course](https://www.knowledgehut.com/programming/ai-in-software-development): AI-powered software development with GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, RAG workflows, and Python training.
- [No Code AI Agents and Automation Course](https://www.knowledgehut.com/programming/no-code-ai-agents-and-automation-course): No-code AI agents and automation using n8n, Langflow, ChatGPT API for non-programmers.

## Web Development & Programming

- [React JS Course with Certification](https://www.knowledgehut.com/web-development/react-js): React JS developer course with hands-on projects, real-time exercises, cloud labs, and certification.

## Enterprise Training & Consulting

- [Corporate Training and Development Programs](https://www.knowledgehut.com/corporate-training): Corporate training programs with customized courses, hands-on sessions, and immersive learning.
- [Business Agility Course](https://www.knowledgehut.com/enterprise/business-agility): Business agility training covering Lean-Agile leadership and digital transformation for enterprises.
- [Value Stream Mapping & Optimization Services](https://www.knowledgehut.com/enterprise/value-stream-optimization): Value stream mapping and optimization services leveraging Lean and Agile for process improvement.
- [DevOps Cultural Transformation](https://www.knowledgehut.com/enterprise/devops-cultural-transformation): DevOps cultural transformation services for enterprise agile delivery and organizational development.

## Learning Platforms & Portals

- [KnowledgeHut Homepage](https://www.knowledgehut.com): KnowledgeHut homepage offering bootcamps, certifications in Agile, PMP, Data Science, AI, Cloud Computing.
- [Professional Courses Catalog](https://www.knowledgehut.com/courses): Main course catalog featuring CSM, CSPO, PMP, SAFe certifications and professional training programs.
- [E-Learning Platform](https://www.knowledgehut.com/online): Online learning platform featuring CSM, CSPO, SAFe, PSM-A, and certified expert-led courses.
